title: World Flags Quiz: 20 Flags to Identify
description: Take our world flags quiz: identify 20 national flags, from the famous to the rare. Free, fast and fun geography challenge for flag fans.
h1: World Flags Quiz: Can You Name These Flags?
intro: Think you know your flags? This world flags quiz shows you 20 national flags, one per question, and you have to pick the right country. We start with the most famous ones, the flags you see at sporting events and embassies, then gradually raise the difficulty. The last questions feature rare and look-alike flags that can stump even geography fans. You have about five seconds for each question, so trust your instincts, because your first idea is often right. After every answer, a short explanation shares a detail about the flag. Ready to travel the world in about two minutes?

faq: How many national flags are there in the world?

There are 193 United Nations member states, each with its own national flag, plus observer states such as the Vatican City and Palestine. Dependent territories, regions and organizations have flags too, so the total number of flags depends on how you count.
Which countries have a square flag?

Only two sovereign countries have square national flags: Switzerland and Vatican City. Nearly all other national flags are rectangles. Nepal is the only country with a flag that is not a rectangle or a square, since it consists of two stacked pennants.
What is the study of flags called?

The study of flags is called vexillology, and a person who studies or designs flags is a vexillologist. The word comes from the Latin vexillum, a flag or banner used by the Roman army. Vexillology covers flag history, symbolism and design.
